text:
alex: ok team — pen test retest coming up next week, need to finalize: RBAC freeze window, KMS ephemeral access, and audit-log sampling. who can be liaison for assessor access?

maria: I can take assessor liaison. i'll coordinate creds + readroom. what's the exact window?

alex: starting Mon 2024-06-17 09:00 UTC -> 48h window. needs RBAC changes staged + rollback playbook.

jordan: staging RBAC plan ready. small change: grant assessor role 'assessor/temp-access' with session duration 2h and deny write to prod-secrets.

samir: on KMS — we can't give direct key usage. propose KMS proxy with bounded encrypt/decrypt and audit hooks. ops-liaison, can you confirm proxy availability?

ops-liaison: proxy is available. need a presigned access ticket and ephemeral role mapping. will require IAM policy like: 
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/ephemeral-assess-key","Condition":{"DateLessThan":{"aws:CurrentTime":"2024-06-19T11:00:00Z"}}}
  ]
}
```

maria: perfect — i'll package that into the evidence readroom. also we need audit-log sampling instructions for the assessor: which streams and retention snapshot?

jordan: sampling: authz.log (all allow/deny), kms.audit (key usage), infra.audit (instance creation). export a 24h snapshot starting at window start. retention snapshot ZIP to S3 readroom.

alex: remediation tracking: use vuln-triage board tag `pt-retest` and update with status/proof links. anything else?

samir: add a smoke test for KMS proxy in staging before granting access. one PR to enable proxy, one revert PR. schedule a 30m dry run Fri 2024-06-14 15:00 UTC.

maria: will run dry run and confirm logs show Decrypt events with request-id. add logs snippet to evidence: `kms.audit: requestId=abcd-1234 decrypt resource=ephemeral-assess-key`

sec-bot: Reminder: create ticket SE-PT-6141 with attachments: RBAC plan, KMS policy, readroom link, rollback steps. Deadline: 2024-06-13 EOD.

ops-liaison: noted. i'll create presigned S3 link for readroom and post creds exchange steps.

alex: checklist for liaison: 1) create ephemeral role 2) enable KMS proxy 3) run staging smoke test 4) export 24h audit snapshot 5) publish readroom bundle 6) coordinate retest slot with assessor.

maria: echoing checklist. i'll track PRs and post links here. tagging @ops-liaison for the presigned link when ready. :white_check_mark:

jordan: one gating question — can we restrict assessor to IP ranges? if yes, add to presigned policy.

ops-liaison: yes we can. will scope presigned link and ephemeral role to their ASN/IP set.

alex: great. final call: anyone raising blockers?

samir: none from infra beyond the proxy PR timing.

maria: i'll run the dry run and report. expect readroom by Sat morning.

alex: thanks all. i'll file SE-PT-6141 and kick off comms to the assessor.

sec-bot: SE-PT-6141 created: https://redwood.internal/tickets/SE-PT-6141 — attach your artifacts there. 

maria: attaching initial RBAC PR: https://git.redwood/ops/infra/pulls/432 — includes role, trust policy, and TTL.

jordan: reviewing PR now. will leave comments for deny-write constraint.

samir: once PR is merged, ops-liaison please trigger smoke test and paste output here.

ops-liaison: smoke test output: `2024-06-14T15:00:05Z INFO kms-proxy test decrypt requestId=abcd-1234 status=200` — logs visible in staging stack.

maria: perfect. moving to finalize readroom bundle and evidence zip.

alex: can we close coordination? i'll schedule final sync Mon 06:50 UTC before window start.

maria: works for me.

jordan: good to go.

ops-liaison: ready on my side.

alex: closing thread — thanks everyone :v:
